Draw node and edge elements in a 2D graph layout

Source: R/geom-graphspace.R
geom_graphspace.Rd

Deprecated as of v1.4.2. Use geom_edgespace()() + geom_nodespace() instead. These geoms support all current features including node-edge synchronization, labels, multiple edges, and self-loops.

Usage

geom_graphspace(
  mapping = NULL,
  data,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  arrow_size = 0.5,
  arrow_offset = 0.01,
  curve = 0,
  edge_spread = 0.2,
  loop_direction = "adaptive",
  raster = FALSE,
  dpi = NULL,
  dev = "cairo",
  scale = 1
)

Arguments

mapping, data, stat, position, na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

See geom_edgespace and geom_nodespace.

...

Additional arguments passed to the underlying geoms.

arrow_size, arrow_offset, curve, edge_spread, loop_direction

See geom_edgespace.

raster, dpi, dev, scale

See geom_nodespace.

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Note

This function is deprecated. Replace geom_graphspace(data = gs) with geom_edgespace() + geom_nodespace() in your ggplot(gs) call.

See also

geom_nodespace, geom_edgespace
